history.summary: A 1,119 sqft 3BR at $2.4M in Meraprime, D03 Tiong Bahru, 250m from Tiong Bahru MRT (EWL). Clean resale-only 6.94%/yr CAGR on 31 txns and a $2,145 PSF ~4% under the $2,228 URA median, in a prime RCR city-fringe location — a strong combination despite the 2006-vintage leasehold.
history.rating_rationale: The numbers line up well: resale-only 6.94%/yr (no new-launch bias) on 31 txns is above the 30-txn confidence floor and well over the RCR ~5.8% baseline; $2,145 PSF is ~4% below the URA median; the $2.4M quantum is near the top of the deep band but still workable; and 250m to Tiong Bahru MRT in a perennially-desirable D03/Tiong Bahru location underpins both rental and exit. Watch-items are the 2006 lease (now ~80yrs remaining, decay accelerates over a 5-7yr hold) and a $2.4M 3BR being mid-tier rather than mass-market. On balance, the appreciation track record + location + sub-median pricing justify a Buy.
red_flags: 2006 build, 99yr lease ~80yrs remaining — lease decay over the hold period
$2.4M quantum at the upper edge of the deep buyer band
31 txns is just above the confidence floor — credible but not abundant
catalysts: 250m to Tiong Bahru MRT (EWL) in prime RCR city-fringe
Tiong Bahru's enduring lifestyle/heritage appeal sustains demand and rents
PSF ~4% below URA median with a 6.94% resale CAGR track record
